title: String Compression
statement:
Compress a string S using run-length encoding: replace each run of consecutive identical characters with the character followed by its count.

If the compressed string is not shorter than the original, return the original string unchanged.

For example, "aabcccdddd" compresses to "a2b1c3d4" (length 8 < 10), so output "a2b1c3d4".
But "abc" compresses to "a1b1c1" (length 6 > 3), so output "abc".
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: The compressed string if shorter, otherwise the original string.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 10^5
S contains only lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: Compressed length 8 < original length 10, so output compressed.
Compressed 'a1b1c1' has length 6 > 3, so output original.
